en.shaykh-tahir-ridha-jaffer: 1.Al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd narrated to us from Faḍālah ibn Ayyūb, from Abū al-Maghrāʾ, from Zayd al-Shaḥḥām[1], from ʿAmr ibn Saʿīd ibn Hilāl who said, “I told Abū ʿAbdillāh (a), ‘I only get to meet you once every few years, so give me some advice that I can adopt [in the meantime].’
He said, ‘I advise you to be mindful of Allah, to espouse piety, and struggle [for the sake of Allah]. And beware of aspiring to the position of one who is above you.
Indeed, what Allah, to Whom belong might and majesty, told the Messenger of Allah (ṣ) [about this] is sufficient: So do not be impressed by their wealth and children (Q9:55).
And He said: And do not extend your gaze [yearningly] at what We have provided their groups of the embellishment of the life of this world (Q20:131).
Indeed, if you fear any of this [happening to you] then recall the life of the Messenger of Allah (ṣ),
